tools.name: find_country
tools.description: Look up a country by common name, ISO 3166 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code, or capital city. Returns the name, codes, capital, region, population, area, languages, currencies, and flag. Use this for a single country profile. Population here is the countries.dev figure; use get_indicator with population for

tools.name: compare_countries
tools.description: Compare two to six countries side by side on capital, region, population, area, languages, and currencies. An exact common name is chosen when a search also returns other countries, such as Guinea among the Guineas. Pass ISO codes when the name is still ambiguous. Use get_indicator to compare GDP, i

tools.name: get_indicator
tools.description: Fetch a World Bank indicator for one or more countries and a year range. Aliases: gdp, gdp_per_capita, gdp_growth, population, inflation, unemployment, life_expectancy, exports. A raw id such as NY.GDP.MKTP.CD also works. Call list_common_indicators to see ids and units. Missing years are omitted. W

tools.name: list_common_indicators
tools.description: List the indicator aliases get_indicator accepts, with the World Bank id, name, and unit. Optionally filter by text in the alias, id, or name. This list is local and does not call the network.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: List countries in one region, or countries that use an ISO 4217 currency. Regions: Africa, Americas, Asia, Europe, Oceania, Antarctic. Pass both to keep only that currency inside the region. Returns a compact roster, not a full profile.

tools.name: fx_rates
tools.description: Convert an amount with European Central Bank reference rates via Frankfurter. Defaults to the latest USD rates. Pass date as YYYY-MM-DD for the rate on that day, or the previous business day when the market was closed. No API key.
